scripts.update:data: npm run fetch:raw && npm run build:data
scripts.validate: node --check app.js && node --check scripts/fetch-wayback-combined.js && node --check scripts/build-tweets-json.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const data=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('data/tweets.json','utf8')); if(!Array.isArray(data)||!data.length) throw new Error('data/tweets.json invalido'); if(new Set(data.map(t=>t.id)).size!==data.length) throw new Error('ids duplicados'); console.log(data.length + ' tweets validos')"
